Reproduce the failure with a run narrowed to the test the output names, fix it, then run that test again and build its project. The whole sweep runs again as soon as you stop with every task tested, so stopping on a fix you have not run costs another one.

CodeOutline on the failing test's file gives the line each test starts on: Read that test's range rather than the whole file.

The chat prompt on both engines (buildSystemPrompt and session-engines.ts's startClaude) now also joins instruction files through the same `instructionsText`/`CLASH_WITH_CORE`. To avoid a duplicate copy of the person's own memory notes (which live inside their instruction file), `MemorySources`/`memorySection`/`withMemories`/`chatMemorySection` in src/agent/memory/session-context.ts now carry the project's index only; the person's own notes ride the instruction files wherever those join, on both engines.
